plugin.name: colorfilter
plugin._long: A colour filter over the whole screen until toggled off: greyscale, sepia, a warm night tint, or simulation and correction of colour-vision deficiencies. Costs nothing extra while the screen does not change.

option.name: toggle
option._long: Switches the filter on and off. Also available as the IPC method colorfilter/toggle.

option.name: filter
option._long: The filter to apply. "simulate" shows how the screen looks with that colour-vision deficiency; "correct" shifts the colours a person with it cannot tell apart into ones they can (daltonize).

option.name: strength
option._long: How strongly the filter is applied, in percent (0 = off, 100 = full).
